note: jsoncli is a pure spawner bridge: one JSON request argument {kind} in, one JSON reply line {ok,kind,rendered,faces} out. All model semantics stay in MoonBit and are gated with the module itself.
pinRule: bundleSha256 and bytes are asserted by tools/validate-plugin.mjs: the model semantics live inside this bundle, so an edited or stale copy must fail loudly rather than be discovered at the next release. tools/update-bundle.mjs rewrites all three fields together.
